slides.texte_overlay:
bizarre hobbies that will
make you disgustingly confident

narrating your day

for 10 minutes, quietly narrate what you're doing like a nature documentary. it sounds ridiculous, but it pulls you out of your anxious head and makes you the main character again.

kitchen dancing

dance alone to one full song every morning, curtains open. confidence is mostly how comfortable you are looking silly, and nobody gets there by staying stiff.

wrong hand days

use your non-dominant hand for small tasks for one full day. being clumsy on purpose teaches your brain that struggling is normal, not proof that you're failing.

tiny facts

spend 5 minutes a day learning one strange fact about history, art or the human body, then tell someone. sharing what you learn is how quiet people slowly become the most interesting ones in the room.

saying your name slowly

every time you introduce yourself this week, say your name slowly and clearly, no mumbling. how you say your own name tells people how much space you think you deserve.
